props.caption: Zaporizhzhia, where a guided bomb hit a five-story residential building in the early hours of 10 October.
Northern Gulf waters where 129 production platforms had personnel taken off.
Nationwide lycée protests, now counted as police-misconduct cases in Paris.

items.note: A five-story entrance collapsed at second-floor level. Counts of seven and five dead remain unmerged.
Isaias came ashore near Destin at 105 mph on Friday. It had already dropped from Category 3.
Personnel off 129 of 371 manned platforms. Friday's operator reports do not print shut-in barrels.
OFAC listed the court at The Hague on October 9. General licenses still cover some transactions.
Eighteen misconduct inquiries are open. The first officer facing potential prosecution is suspended.
RBI will sell dollars to three oil companies from Monday. Banks, price and volume remain unpublished.

lead.what: Yes if the National Hurricane Center posts, by 12:00 UTC on 10 October 2026, an advisory with maximum sustained winds of at least 111 mph for Hurricane Isaias at or before northern-Gulf landfall; no if no such advisory is posted by that deadline. Guardian s-a2e8afcd quotes the National Hurricane Center at 120 mph mid-morning Friday, then 110 mph Friday evening, still before Destin landfall. NOLA and Weather.com in s-1c766683 reported 120 mph Category 3 Friday morning. Landfall at 105 mph in s-9c4802a1 does not unwind that earlier NHC reading, posted before 12:00 UTC 10 October.

Yes if the International Energy Agency or an IEA member energy ministry posts, by 16:00 UTC on 22 October 2026, a dated withdrawal of remaining oil stocks pledged under the March 2026 Collective Action; no if no such post by that deadline. The prior is 0.55.

rest.what: Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then. The prior is 0.28.

Yes if Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral names Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 25 October 2026 presidential runoff; no if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is named the winner, or if no runoff winner is named. The prior is 0.58.

lead.what: Guided aerial bombs hit a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia on the morning of Saturday, 10 October. Ukrainska Pravda put seven dead and ten wounded; Espreso put five dead, including two children.

rest.what: Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin, Florida, at 8:30 p.m. Central Time on Friday, 9 October, at 105 mph, a Category 2 storm, then weakened to Category 1 over land.
The Marine Minerals Administration put personnel off 129 production platforms, 34.77% of 371 manned platforms, from operator reports as of 11:00 a.m. CDT Friday.
